# GamesAI for MCDReforged English | [简体中文](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main//README.zh-CN.md) | [繁體中文](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main//README.zh-TW.md) [Report an Issue](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/issues/new) | [Share an Idea](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/discussions/new/choose) | [Join QQ Group](https://qm.qq.com/q/jDQQaUPNmw) [Go to Fabric Version](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/GamesAI)
> [!NOTE] > **GamesAI Plugin/Mod QQ Group: 849544707** — Join us to discuss issues, share feedback, and exchange prompt, skills, tools configurations! > [!NOTE] > Welcome to version 0.8.0! This release adds **cross-server linking**: several MCDR instances form one cluster over WebSocket, one of them becomes the hub that owns the AI, the conversation history and the public database, and the others join as clients that forward their players' commands (the cluster-wide ones they run themselves); tools stay per instance -- every request carries the asking instance's local tool schemas. The Mineflayer bot joins the cluster as a client as well, instead of listening on a port of its own. See [the cross-server guide](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/cross-server.md). Every conversation is also **stored** (in a `chat_history` table of the same database file as `!!data`), so a reload, an update, a restart or removing the plugin no longer loses it, and a user's assistant can hand one message to another user's conversation with the new `send_message_to_player_ai` tool. The newest additions keep a stopped round's history (`!!ask stop`) and let an operator clear one player's history by name (`!!gamesai clear `).

## Installation Run the following command in the MCDR console to install the plugin: `!!MCDR plugin install games_ai` Requirements: Python 3.12 or newer and MCDReforged 2.15.0 or newer (the manifest declares `mcdreforged >= 2.15.0`; MCDR runs the plugin on its own interpreter). Node.js 18+ with npm is needed only when you enable the Mineflayer bot. --- Alternatively, get it from the [MCDR Plugin Repository](https://mcdreforged.com/plugin/games_ai) and place it in your plugin directory. If you choose to install manually, the plugin takes care of its Python packages itself: on the first start it looks for `openai`, `requests` and `websockets`, installs whatever is missing with pip (the machine's own pip configuration first, the Aliyun PyPI mirror as a second attempt) and reloads itself when that worked. You only have to step in when both attempts fail -- the log then prints the exact command to run, in the `python -m pip` form: ```bash python -m pip install openai requests websockets ``` `!!MCDR plugin install games_ai` cannot pre-install anything either: the package list lives inside the plugin (`games_ai/requirements.txt`), and MCDR only reads a `requirements.txt` at the plugin root before loading it. Every install route therefore starts with the packages missing, and the plugin repairs them itself on the first start (see [PIM](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/pim.md)); use the manual command above only when both pip attempts fail, and run `!!MCDR plugin reload games_ai` afterwards to bring the plugin back. Coming from an older release needs no manual config edit: the old `mineflayer_bot.websocket.url` is migrated to the top-level `websocket.uri` on the first load. In a cluster, a node running an older build cannot obey the hub's update order, so install the new build by hand once on every instance (`!!MCDR plugin install -U -y games_ai`). Only the hub needs a reachable port, and a `wss://` uri can only be a client. GamesAI maintains itself: the plugin updates its own file (cluster-aware, verified download, rollback on failure) and repairs its own Python packages. Both are described in [PIM: the plugin's own installer](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/pim.md). ## Quick Start ### 1. First start: let the plugin install what it needs Put the plugin into `plugins/` and start the server (if it is already installed, `!!MCDR plugin reload games_ai` is enough). On the first start it checks its three Python packages (`openai`, `requests`, `websockets`) and installs whatever is missing with pip -- the machine's own pip configuration first, the Aliyun PyPI mirror as a second attempt -- then reloads itself: ```text Installing the missing Python package(s) with pip: ... [deps] ... Dependencies installed; reloading the plugin... Dependencies are ready; the plugin is fully loaded again (openai, requests, websockets) ``` While that runs, the plugin is loaded but idle: it registers no command and starts neither the bot nor the cross-server link. If both attempts fail, the log prints `Could not install: ...` together with the command to run by hand (`python -m pip install openai requests websockets`); run it, then `!!MCDR plugin reload games_ai`. See [PIM: the Python package manager](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/pim.md#the-python-package-manager) and [Missing Python Packages](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/troubleshooting.md#missing-python-packages). ### 2. Configure an AI Open `config/games_ai/config.json` (created on the first start) and fill in one `all_ai` entry plus `default_ai`: ```json { "all_ai": { "": { "prompt": "You are a mature, reliable Minecraft assistant.", "ai_name": "[GamesAI]", "base_url": "", "ai_model": "", "api_key": "", "extra_body": {} } }, "default_ai": "" } ``` - `all_ai` holds one entry per model; the key you choose is the plugin's internal AI ID. - `base_url`, `ai_model` and `api_key` are your provider's OpenAI-compatible endpoint, model name and key. - `ai_name` is what the AI prefixes its answers with (Minecraft formatting codes work). - `extra_body` is passed to the provider untouched -- for a thinking model, for example `{"thinking": {"type": "enabled"}}`. - `default_ai` must be exactly one of the `all_ai` keys: it is the model a plain `!!ask` uses. - Optional `context_window` overrides the window that [automatic context management](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/ai-request-pipeline.md#automatic-context-management) uses for that model. Keep long prompts out of the file by writing `"prompt": "> my_prompt.md"`: the text is then read from `config/games_ai/prompt/my_prompt.md`. Apply the change with `!!gamesai reload`. `!!gamesai config get ` and `!!gamesai config set ` handle simple top-level keys, but `config set` refuses the complex `all_ai` and `mineflayer_bot` blocks and does not resolve dotted keys, so edit those in the file. Every key is documented in [Configuration](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/configuration.md#3all_ai). ### 3. Check the connection and ask the first question `!!gamesai speedtest` asks every configured model at `/models` and prints the latency (`!!gamesai speedtest ` tests a single one). Then simply talk to it: ```text !!ask Hello! Are you there? ``` `!!ask` is open to every player. Around it: `!!ask -n ` answers without the conversation history, `!!ask -f ` (alias `--forced`) merges the question into the round that is already running, `!!ask switch ` hands the conversation to another model (the old one summarizes it first), `!!ask stop` stops everything you have in flight and **keeps what the round already wrote**, and `!!ask context [player]` / `!!ask context --all` show how much context is in use. See [AI Request Pipeline](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/ai-request-pipeline.md#context-inspection) and [Stopping a running round](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/ai-request-pipeline.md#stopping-a-running-round). ### 4. Where the conversation lives (and how to clear it) Every conversation is written into a `chat_history` table of `config/games_ai/database/public_database.db` -- the same file as `!!data`, a separate table -- after every finished round, and restored on every plugin load. A reload, an update, a restart or removing the plugin therefore no longer loses it. `!!gamesai clear` deletes your own conversation; `!!gamesai clear ` deletes another player's (it needs the configured `permission` level and stops that player's running round first); `!!gamesai clearall` deletes all of them (also permission-gated). See [Conversation persistence](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/ai-request-pipeline.md#conversation-persistence). ### 5. Give the AI abilities: tools and skills (optional) The plugin ships 27 built-in tools (world queries, public data, skills, the bot). Which ones a request is offered depends on the player's MCDR permission level and the configured `permission`, so a low-level player never sees the administrative ones at all. - **Your own tools**: `config/games_ai/tools/tools.py` is created on the first start with a `@register_tool` skeleton. Add your functions there and run `!!gamesai reload`. See [Tools](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/tools.md#2-custom-tools-in-toolspy). - **Skills**: `config/games_ai/skills/skills.json` indexes the skill files the AI reads with `read_skills`; the AI can also write and maintain them itself. See [Skills](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/skills.md#3-adding-your-own-skills). ### 6. Let it drive a Mineflayer bot (optional) Node.js 18+ and npm have to be installed on the server machine. Then set the credentials and start it: ```text !!aibot set username !!aibot set password !!aibot set auth microsoft !!aibot join ``` `!!aibot leave` stops it again. In `config.json` the same settings live under `mineflayer_bot`: `enabled`, `cycle_interval` (how often the autonomous controller decides, 15 seconds by default) and `bot.username` / `bot.password` / `bot.auth` (`microsoft`, `mojang` or `offline`). The bot joins the cluster as a client instead of listening on a port of its own, and the server address is read from `server.properties`. Credentials are only read when the Node process (re)starts, so change them with `!!aibot set` and restart (`!!aibot leave`, then `!!aibot join`); `!!gamesai config set` refuses the whole `mineflayer_bot` block. See [Mineflayer Bot](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/mineflayer-bot.md#commands). ### 7. Link several instances into a cluster (optional) One instance becomes the **hub** (it owns the AI, the conversation history and the public database) and the others join it as **clients** that forward their players' commands; tools stay with each instance. Point every instance at the hub in the `websocket` block of `config.json`: ```json { "websocket": { "uri": "ws://:8080", "force_server": false, "name": "" } } ``` An instance that finds a GamesAI hub at that address becomes a client; one that finds nothing (and can bind the address) becomes the hub, while `force_server` insists on the hub role. Enrolment is per node: on the hub, `!!gamesai node pending` lists the waiting names and `!!gamesai node token ` issues a token; that instance joins with `!!gamesai node claim `. `websocket.name` is derived from the instance directory when it is left empty. Cluster updates are ordered by the hub -- nodes first, hub last. The remaining keys (`allow_app_id`, `token_ttl_hours`, `auto_enroll`, `identity_file`) are documented in [Configuration §6](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/configuration.md#6websocket); the full picture is in [Cross-server Linking](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/cross-server.md#enrolment-one-token-per-instance) and [Cluster updates](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/cross-server.md#cluster-updates). ### 8. Everyday maintenance - `!!gamesai reload` re-reads the configuration, the skills and the tools and restarts the bot when needed; the cross-server link keeps running. Changes to `websocket.*` need `!!MCDR plugin reload games_ai` (or `!!gamesai node claim` / `node forget`, which rebuild the link), because the link is built on load. See [Hot Reload](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/hot-reload.md#triggering-a-hot-reload). - `!!gamesai check` looks for a new release and refreshes the context-window table; in a cluster the hub coordinates it. The plugin updates its own file (verified download, rollback on failure) and repairs its own Python packages -- see [PIM](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/pim.md). - `!!gamesai debug` toggles the full request log; `!!gamesai debug thread` lists the threads the plugin owns. - `!!data` manages the public key/value database the AI can read. - Something broken? [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/troubleshooting.md) lists the log lines and what to do about them. --- ### Command reference Type `!!gamesai` for the in-game feature list (`!!gamesai node …` for cluster enrolment, `!!aibot …` for the bot); the tables below cover the most used commands. | Command | Description | | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | `!!gamesai clear` | Clear your own chat history. It is stored in its own table of the public database file, and this deletes your row. `!!gamesai clear ` clears one other player's history instead and requires the configured `permission` level; a round that player still has in flight is stopped first. | | `!!gamesai clearall` | Clear all players' chat history (the stored rows included). | | `!!gamesai reload` | Reload the configuration, the skills and the tools and restart the bot; the cross-server link keeps running. See [Hot Reload](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/hot-reload.md#hot-reload) for details. | | `!!gamesai check` | Check for plugin updates and force-refresh the context-window table. In a cluster this is executed on the hub, which starts an update round: the nodes install first, the hub last (see [Cross-server Linking](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/cross-server.md#cluster-updates)). | | `!!gamesai speedtest [model]` | Test API server connection latency. If no model is specified, all models are tested. | | `!!gamesai config get ` | Read a configuration value. | | `!!gamesai config set ` | Update a configuration value (auto type-adapts; automatically triggers [Hot Reload](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/hot-reload.md#hot-reload)). | | `!!gamesai node ` | Cluster enrolment and node management; see [Cross-server Linking](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/cross-server.md#enrolment-one-token-per-instance). | | `!!aibot join | leave` | Start or stop the Mineflayer bot; `!!aibot set ` edits the bot credentials and reloads. See [Mineflayer Bot](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/mineflayer-bot.md). | --- You can also use `!!ask` directly to ask the AI questions, chat, or ask it to do things for you. | Command | Description | | ------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | `!!ask ` | Ask the AI a question, chat, or ask it to do something. `` is what you want the AI to do or the question you want to ask. | | `!!ask -n ` | Ask the AI without using conversation history (current conversation is still saved). | | `!!ask -f ` | Force-ask without waiting: the request is merged into the round that is currently running (alias: `--forced`). See [AI Request Pipeline & Chat Mechanism](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/ai-request-pipeline.md#ai-request-pipeline--chat-mechanism). | | `!!ask switch ` | Switch the AI model for your current conversation (`` is the AI_ID or nickname). The history is cleared and the old model summarizes it right before your next request, handing the summary to the new model. See [Summary Hand-off on Model Switch](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/ai-request-pipeline.md#summary-hand-off-on-model-switch). | | `!!ask stop` | Immediately stop everything you have in flight: your running round (tool calls included), a running `!!ask -n` request and a task you delegated to the bot. **What the round already wrote stays in the history** -- only a tool call whose result never arrived is dropped; queued `!!ask -f` messages are kept and merged by your next round. See [Stopping a running round](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/ai-request-pipeline.md#stopping-a-running-round). | | `!!ask context [player]` | Show the context usage: model and window source, how much of the window is used, how many tokens are left before compression, the per-round sizes and the cache-hit rate. Without a player name it shows your own. See [Context Inspection](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/ai-request-pipeline.md#context-inspection). | | `!!ask context --all` | Sum the context usage of every player on the server, grouped by model (models with zero usage are not listed); hover for that model's totals since those conversations were created (they survive a reload and a restart). See [Context Inspection](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/ai-request-pipeline.md#context-inspection). | | `!!ask compact` | Compress the older history right now, ignoring the compression triggers. It is performed by the preflight of your next question, so the command itself never blocks. See [Context Inspection](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/ai-request-pipeline.md#context-inspection). | --- Type `!!data` for information about database commands. > [!TIP] > The database is created automatically on the first start -- no upgrade step is needed. | Command | Description | | ---------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | | `!!data write ` | Add a data entry to the public database. `` must not contain spaces; `` can be any string. | | `!!data add ` | Append `` to an existing key in the public database. Creates a new key if it does not exist. | | `!!data del ` | Delete a data entry from the public database, regardless of whether the key exists. | | `!!data read ` | Read the value associated with a key from the public database. | | `!!data list` | Read all entries in the public database. | | `!!data list keys` | Read all keys in the public database. | --- ## Technical Documentation The technical ## 安装 在MCDR控制台中使用如下命令以安装插件 `!!MCDR plugin install games_ai` 环境要求：Python 3.12 或更高、MCDReforged 2.15.0 或更高（清单声明 `mcdreforged >= 2.15.0`；插件运行在 MCDR 自己的解释器上）。仅在启用 Mineflayer 假人时才需要 Node.js 18+ 与 npm。 --- 或者在[MCDR插件仓库](https://mcdreforged.com/plugin/games_ai)中获取并安装到你的插件目录内 如果选择手动安装：插件的 Python 包由它自己处理 —— 首次启动时检查 `openai`、`requests`、`websockets`，缺哪个就用 pip 补装（先用本机 pip 配置，失败了再用阿里云 PyPI 镜像重试），装好之后自动重载插件。只有两次都失败时才需要你介入，日志里会给出可以直接复制的命令（`python -m pip` 形式）： ```bash python -m pip install openai requests websockets ``` `!!MCDR plugin install games_ai` 也无法预先安装任何东西：包清单位于插件内部（`games_ai/requirements.txt`），而 MCDR 只读取插件根目录下的 `requirements.txt`，然后才加载插件。因此哪种安装方式一开始都缺这些包，插件会在首次启动时自行补装（见 [PIM](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/zh_cn/pim.md)）；只有两次 pip 尝试都失败时，才用上面的手动命令，装完后执行 `!!MCDR plugin reload games_ai` 让插件重新加载。 从旧版本升级无需手动改配置：旧的 `mineflayer_bot.websocket.url` 会在首次加载时迁移为顶层的 `websocket.uri`。集群中，运行旧构建的节点无法听从 hub 的更新顺序，所以要在每个实例上手动安装一次新构建（`!!MCDR plugin install -U -y games_ai`）。只有 hub 需要有可被访问的端口，而 `wss://` 的 uri 只能作为客户端。 插件会自己维护自己：更新器会替换插件自己的文件（集群感知、下载校验、失败回滚），Python 包管理器会补装缺失的包。两者见 [PIM：插件自己的安装管理器](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/zh_cn/pim.md)。 ## 快速上手 ### 1. 首次启动：让插件自己把依赖装好 把插件放进 `plugins/`，启动服务器（已经装过时执行 `!!MCDR plugin reload games_ai` 即可）。首次启动时它会检查三个 Python 包（`openai`、`requests`、`websockets`），缺哪个就用 pip 补装 —— 先用本机 pip 配置，失败后改用阿里云 PyPI 镜像重试 —— 然后重载自己： ```text Installing the missing Python package(s) with pip: ... [deps] ... Dependencies installed; reloading the plugin... Dependencies are ready; the plugin is fully loaded again (openai, requests, websockets) ``` 这期间插件处于"已加载但不工作"状态：不注册命令、不启动假人，也不建立跨服链路。两次尝试都失败时，日志会打出 `Could not install: ...` 以及需要手动执行的命令（`python -m pip install openai requests websockets`）；执行它，再 `!!MCDR plugin reload games_ai`。详见 [PIM：Python 包管理器](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/zh_cn/pim.md#python-包管理器)与[缺少 Python 依赖包](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/zh_cn/troubleshooting.md#缺少-python-依赖包)。 ### 2. 配置一个 AI 打开 `config/games_ai/config.json`（首次启动时自动生成），填好一个 `all_ai` 条目和 `default_ai`： ```json { "all_ai": { "<你的 AI ID>": { "prompt": "你是一个成熟可靠的 Minecraft 助手。", "ai_name": "[GamesAI]", "base_url": "<你的 API Base URL>", "ai_model": "<你的 AI 模型>", "api_key": "<你的 API Key>", "extra_body": {} } }, "default_ai": "<你的 AI ID>" } ``` - `all_ai` 里每个条目是一个模型，条目的键就是插件的内部 AI_ID。 - `base_url`、`ai_model`、`api_key` 分别是服务商的 OpenAI 兼容接口地址、模型名和密钥。 - `ai_name` 是 AI 回复时使用的前缀（支持 Minecraft 格式代码）。 - `extra_body` 会原样传给服务商 —— 例如思考模型可以写 `{"thinking": {"type": "enabled"}}`。 - `default_ai` 必须正好等于 `all_ai` 里的某个键：它就是直接 `!!ask` 时使用的模型。 - 可选的 `context_window` 用来覆盖该模型的[上下文自动管理](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/zh_cn/ai-request-pipeline.md#上下文自动管理)窗口。 提示词很长时不必写进配置文件：把 `prompt` 写成 `"> my_prompt.md"`，正文会从 `config/games_ai/prompt/my_prompt.md` 读取。 改完执行 `!!gamesai reload`。`!!gamesai config get ` 与 `!!gamesai config set ` 可以处理顶层简单键，但 `config set` 会拒绝复杂的 `all_ai` 与 `mineflayer_bot` 块，也不会解析带点的键，这两块请在文件里改。全部键的含义见[配置](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/zh_cn/configuration.md#3all_ai)。 ### 3. 验证连通并问出第一句话 `!!gamesai speedtest` 会向每个模型的 `/models` 发一次请求并打印延迟（`!!gamesai speedtest ` 只测一个）。然后直接和它说话： ```text !!ask 你好，你在吗？ ``` `!!ask` 对所有玩家开放。围绕它的还有：`!!ask -n ` 不带历史回答，`!!ask -f `（别名 `--forced`）把问题并入正在运行的那一轮，`!!ask switch ` 把对话交给另一个模型（旧模型先做摘要转接），`!!ask stop` 停掉你名下所有在途工作并**保留本轮已经写入的内容**，`!!ask context [玩家]` / `!!ask context --all` 查看上下文占用。详见 [AI 请求链路](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/zh_cn/ai-request-pipeline.md#上下文查看)与[停止正在进行的对话](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/zh_cn/ai-request-pipeline.md#停止正在进行的对话)。 ### 4. 对话存在哪里（以及怎么清理） 每条对话都会在每轮结束后写入 `config/games_ai/database/public_database.db` 的 `chat_history` 表（与 `!!data` 同一个文件、不同的表），并在每次插件加载时恢复。因此重载、更新、重启乃至卸载插件都不会再丢失。 `!!gamesai clear` 删除你自己的对话；`!!gamesai clear ` 删除指定玩家的对话（需要配置的 `permission` 等级，会先停掉对方正在跑的回合）；`!!gamesai clearall` 删除所有人的（同样需要权限）。详见[对话持久化](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/zh_cn/ai-request-pipeline.md#对话持久化)。 ### 5. 给 AI 加能力：工具与技能（可选） 插件自带 27 个内置工具（世界查询、公共数据、技能、假人）。一次请求能拿到哪些工具，取决于玩家的 MCDR 权限等级与配置里的 `permission` —— 低等级玩家根本看不到管理类工具。 - **自定义工具**：首次启动会生成 `config/games_ai/tools/tools.py`，里面带一个 `@register_tool` 骨架；把你的函数写进去，然后 `!!gamesai reload`。详见[工具](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/zh_cn/tools.md#2-在-toolspy-中自定义工具)。 - **技能**：`config/games_ai/skills/skills.json` 是技能索引，AI 通过 `read_skills` 读取其中列出的文件，也可以自己写和维护。详见[技能](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/zh_cn/skills.md#3-添加自己的技能)。 ### 6. 让 AI 开一个假人（可选） 服务器上需要安装 Node.js 18+ 与 npm。然后设置凭据并启动： ```text !!aibot set username !!aibot set password <密码> !!aibot set auth microsoft !!aibot join ``` `!!aibot leave` 再次停掉它。`config.json` 里对应的设置是 `mineflayer_bot` 下的 `enabled`、`cycle_interval`（自治控制器多久决策一次，默认 15 秒）与 `bot.username` / `bot.password` / `bot.auth`（`microsoft`、`mojang` 或 `offline`）。假人作为客户端接入集群，自己不开端口；服务器地址从 `server.properties` 读取。`username`/`password`/`auth` 只在 Node 进程（重）启动时读取，所以改完要用 `!!aibot set` 并重启（`!!aibot leave`，再 `!!aibot join`）；`!!gamesai config set` 会拒绝整个 `mineflayer_bot` 块。详见 [Mineflayer 假人](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/zh_cn/mineflayer-bot.md#指令)。 ### 7. 把多台实例连成集群（可选） 其中一台成为 **hub**（拥有 AI、对话历史与公共数据库），其余实例作为**客户端**接入并转发玩家的命令；工具仍各实例自带。在每台实例 `config.json` 的 `websocket` 块里指向 hub： ```json { "websocket": { "uri": "ws://:8080", "force_server": false, "name": "" } } ``` 在该地址上探测到 GamesAI hub 的实例会成为客户端；什么都没探测到（且自己绑得住该地址）的实例会当 hub，`force_server` 则强制当 hub。入网按节点进行：在 hub 上用 `!!gamesai node pending` 看等待名单，`!!gamesai node token ` 签发 token，目标实例自己用 `!!gamesai node claim ` 入网。`websocket.name` 留空时由实例目录派生。集群更新由 hub 排序 —— 先节点、后 hub。其余键（`allow_app_id`、`token_ttl_hours`、`auto_enroll`、`identity_file`）见[配置 §6](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/zh_cn/configuration.md#6websocket)；完整说明见[跨服连接](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/zh_cn/cross-server.md#注册每个实例一份-token)与[集群更新](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/zh_cn/cross-server.md#集群更新)。 ### 8. 日常维护 - `!!gamesai reload` 重新读取配置、技能与工具，必要时重启假人；跨服链路继续运行。`websocket.*` 的改动要用 `!!MCDR plugin reload games_ai`（或 `!!gamesai node claim` / `node forget`，它们会重建链路），因为链路是在加载时建立的。详见[热重载](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/zh_cn/hot-reload.md#触发热重载)。 - `!!gamesai check` 检查是否有新版本，并刷新上下文窗口表；集群里由 hub 协调。插件会更新自己的文件（下载校验、失败回滚）并自我修复 Python 包 —— 见 [PIM](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/zh_cn/pim.md)。 - `!!gamesai debug` 切换完整请求日志；`!!gamesai debug thread` 列出插件持有的线程。 - `!!data` 管理 AI 可读的公共键值数据库。 - 出问题了？看[故障排查](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/zh_cn/troubleshooting.md)，里面按日志行给出处理办法。 --- ### 命令速查 输入 `!!gamesai` 可查看游戏内功能列表（`!!gamesai node …` 用于集群注册，`!!aibot …` 用于假人）；下表列出的是最常用的指令。 | 指令 | 用途 | | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | `!!gamesai clear` | 清除你自己的历史聊天记录。它存放在公共数据库文件的独立数据表中,该指令会删除你那一行。`!!gamesai clear ` 改为清除另一位玩家的历史记录，需要达到配置中的 `permission` 等级；该玩家还在进行的对话轮会先被停止。 | | `!!gamesai clearall` | 清除所有玩家的历史聊天记录(包括已存储的行)。 | | `!!gamesai reload` | 重新加载配置、技能与工具并重启 Bot；跨服链路会继续运行。详见[热重载](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/zh_cn/hot-reload.md#热重载)。 | | `!!gamesai check` | 检查插件更新，并强制刷新上下文窗口表。集群里由 hub 执行并发起一轮更新：节点先装、hub 最后装（见[跨服连接](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/zh_cn/cross-server.md#集群更新)） | | `!!gamesai speedtest [model]` | 测试 API 服务器连接延迟，不指定模型时测试全部 | | `!!gamesai config get ` | 读取一个配置项的值。 | | `!!gamesai config set ` | 修改一个配置项的值（自动适配旧值类型，修改后自动触发[热重载](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/zh_cn/hot-reload.md#热重载)）。 | | `!!gamesai node ` | 集群注册与节点管理；见[跨服连接](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/zh_cn/cross-server.md#注册每个实例一份-token)。 | | `!!aibot join | leave` | 启动或停止假人（Mineflayer bot）；`!!aibot set ` 可修改假人凭据并重载。见 [Mineflayer Bot](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/zh_cn/mineflayer-bot.md)。 | --- 你也可以直接输入`!!ask`向AI提问或者聊天或者帮你做一些事情 | 指令 | 用途 | | ---------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | `!!ask ` | 向AI提问或者聊天或者帮你做一些事情，content为你想让AI做的事情或者你想问AI的问题 | | `!!ask -n ` | 向AI提问但不使用历史记录（当前对话仍会被保存） | | `!!ask -f ` | 强制提问：不等待当前轮结束，将消息并入正在运行的对话轮（别名 `--forced`）。详见[AI 请求链路与对话机制](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/zh_cn/ai-request-pipeline.md#ai-请求链路与对话机制)。 | | `!!ask switch ` | 切换当前对话使用的 AI 模型，model为AI_ID或昵称。切换时清空历史，并在你下次提问前由旧模型压缩为摘要转接给新模型，详见[切换模型时的摘要转接](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/zh_cn/ai-request-pipeline.md#切换模型时的摘要转接)。 | | `!!ask stop` | 立即停止你名下所有正在进行的对话：运行中的对话轮（含工具调用）、正在进行的 `!!ask -n` 提问、以及你委派给 Bot 的任务。**本轮已经写入的内容会保留在历史里** —— 只有结果始终没有回来的那个工具调用会被丢弃；`!!ask -f` 排队消息会保留，由你下一轮合并。详见[停止正在进行的对话](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/zh_cn/ai-request-pipeline.md#停止正在进行的对话)。 | | `!!ask context [玩家]` | 查看上下文占用：模型与窗口来源、已用比例、距离压缩还有多少余量、逐轮规模与缓存命中。不填玩家即查看自己。详见[上下文查看](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/zh_cn/ai-request-pipeline.md#上下文查看)。 | | `!!ask context --all` | 按模型汇总全服所有玩家的上下文用量（零用量的模型不列出），悬停可看该模型自这些对话创建以来的累计用量（重载与重启都不会丢失）。详见[上下文查看](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/zh_cn/ai-request-pipeline.md#上下文查看)。 | | `!!ask compact` | 立即压缩较早的历史（忽略窗口触发线），由你下次提问前的预检完成，指令本身不阻塞。详见[上下文查看](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/zh_cn/ai-request-pipeline.md#上下文查看)。 | --- 输入`!!data`获取有关数据库指令的信息 > [!TIP] > 数据库会在首次启动时自动创建，无需额外的升级步骤。 | 指令 | 用途 | | ---------------------------- | --------------------------------------- | | `!!data write ` | 在公共数据库内添加一条数据，其中key不能包含空格，value可以是任意字符串 | | `!!data add ` | 将value追加到公共数据库中的key中，不存在时自动创建新key | | `!!data del ` | 在公共数据库内删除一条数据，无论key是否存在 | | `!!data read ` | 读取公共数据库中key对应的value | | `!!data list` | 读取公共数据库中的所有内容 | | `!!data list keys` | 读取公共数据库中的所有key | ---
